blocks.text: Campbell Valley homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

Campbell Valley, October 2026. Detached houses: 19 listed at month end and 2 sold in October, a sales ratio of 11% (a buyers’ market). No condos and townhomes were listed or sold in Campbell Valley between June and October.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 4 sold over 5 months against an average of 16.6 listed, about 20.8 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 2 sold.
